Verdicts roll up to three outcomes that follow ACM’s “Results Reproduced” badge

NOT_REPRODUCEDany check failed
REPRODUCED the evaluator re-executed or re-analyzed every assessed claim; a badge names the method
PARTIAL everything else, e.g. a claim settled by inspection or attestation
ACM badgeAwarded when
Availablea license file and a resolvable paper
Functionaldependencies and experiments declared; no structural failure
Results Reproducedthe rubric is REPRODUCED

Without re-running anything, the ceiling is PARTIAL. “Reusable” needs human judgment and stays with reviewers.
